name: A-overlap-ribbon
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original macOS app icon concept for MyGit, a native multi-repository Git and worktree client. Full square canvas, edge-to-edge pale frosted mint-gray background, leave platform corner masking for later. Center a bold compact sculptural mark made from two broad rounded translucent ribbons crossing and branching, evoking parallel paths coming together, with an energetic asymmetric silhouette. Coral pink ribbon and cobalt blue ribbon, dark violet overlap, restrained turquoise reflected accent. Clear ivory rim around the overall colorful symbol, soft believable thickness and tiny contact shadow. Mark occupies 72% of canvas, extremely legible at Dock size. Friendly, tactile, sophisticated. Reference taste: colorful overlapping rounded strokes on frosted app tiles; derive material and proportion only, invent a distinct new symbol. Avoid letters, text, conventional Git circles-and-lines diagram, generic infinity loop, sparkles and excessive decoration. One icon only, straight-on, no labels, no surrounding mockup.

name: B-folded-path
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original macOS app icon concept for MyGit, native multi-repository Git and worktree client. Full square edge-to-edge warm porcelain white background, platform mask will be added later. Center one bold folded ribbon sculpture: a continuous broad blue strip rises from lower-left, curves across center and splits into two upward folded fins, one turquoise and one lavender. The whole outline feels compact, surprising and balanced, like a paper bird or a branching current, but without literal bird features. Broad crisp folds, rich royal blue front face, teal upper plane, subtle violet inner fold, very restrained soft contact shadow, mostly flat color faces with gentle material shading. 75% visual occupancy, recognisable at 32 px. Inspiration is the confident large color planes and clean white tile of a polished productivity app, without copying any existing mark. No text, no letters, no conventional Git nodes, no tiny elements, no chrome, no sparkles. Single square icon artwork only, straight-on.

name: C-mechanical-scout
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original macOS app icon concept for MyGit, native multi-repository Git and worktree client. Full square canvas with edge-to-edge deep blue-black background, platform rounded masking will be added later. A compact friendly futuristic mechanical scout character, centered frontal bust, large head and small shoulders, strong clean silhouette with two short swept upward antenna fins suggesting diverging paths. Dark graphite shell, glossy cyan face visor with two simple bright mint eyes, cobalt blue armored cheeks and one restrained lime accent. Premium stylized 3D collectible with polished edges, subtle blue rim light, clear large shapes, confident and approachable rather than aggressive. Face occupies most of icon so it reads at Dock size. Inspired by the appeal of neon mechanical character icons, invent an original character. Keep lighting controlled; no bloom haze, no detailed circuitry, no weapons, no text, no logo, no surrounding mockup. One square icon only.
